_doc: Ledger 0054 P0 (2026-10-14): the proofs behind P0 step 6 and the terrain-plan rehearsal, run on scratch copies (never the workshop, never AC). Scripts are kept as the method of record; their paths are arguments.

remap_sample_cache.proof.json.what: tools/remap_sample_cache.py on the installed v0.18.0 cache (scratch copy), --rows-n 37 --cols-w 26: every key's position, h_cm byte identity, 1,000 random nodes (seed 54).

heightfield_grow.proof.json.what: p0_heightfield_proof.py: A grid_grow absent reproduces the installed npy/meta byte for byte; B HEAD vs new heightfield.py byte-identical under a bit-keyed sampler; C grid_grow 37/37/26 old nodes bit-identical + frame pin = remap frame; D the north route's kept cells inside the grown grid.

terrain_plan_rehearsal.json.what: rehearse_terrain.py, offline on a scratch copy of the workshop data: A HEAD config and B the P0 config without D2 reproduce the installed terrain.tiers arrays; C with D2 needs the I-8 corridor rebuilt online (see plan_c.py).

plan_c.py.what: the D2 lattice offline: 301,500 vertices (far 139,483), 34,852 3DEP samples missing (78 requests)
